subject: general
question:
Six persons P, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting equally spaced in a circle facing one another front to front. P is sitting in front of Q.

Q is sitting to the immediate right of T and immediate left of R, P is to the left of U and right of S. Who is sitting opposite to R?
solution:
Person : P, Q, R, S, T and U

1) P is sitting in front of Q;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf3017c83c5b23d2f4f304eebed58f166902176bc5db9a2eb8fbd43fc8e13efc.png] 

2) Q is sitting to the immediate right of T and immediate left of R;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffcc706a2a336c477a91594408164d20fd35516e182eb82b6a2a126eb66d6103.png] 

3) P is sitting to the left of U and right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c9217b280491de4e49301d4674c8702037c16d96ba885bcc52ff5483cf1fd02.png] 

Hence, the correct answe is** "U".**
